title: Immaculate Constellation USAP set up in 2017 to sequester overhead UAP data
summary: UAPGerb tells of Immaculate Constellation USAP set up in 2017 to sequester overhead UAP data, about 2017 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, a program like Immaculate Constellation or a legacy program satellite because Immaculate Constellation isn't a legacy program. It was a it was a reactionary US app established in 2017 would clip out data that would probably depict anomalies like a UFO and sequester it into MCOM or another legacy program site.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a secret programme called Immaculate Constellation was set up in 2017 as a USAP, short for "unacknowledged special access program", a Pentagon project so secret its existence is not admitted. He says it was created in reaction to events, unlike older long-running programmes, and that it cuts out sensor and satellite data showing things like UFOs and hides it away in other secret programmes. If true, it would mean the government is quietly hiding its best UFO evidence.
